full_judgment: 7. Mr. Abdul Wadud Bhuiyan, learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, submits that the petitioner-defendant No. 1 in the suit filed an application before the Court to direct the plaintiff to execute the Kabla and take registration after payment of the remaining consideration money of Tk. 50,00,000/- and the date was fixed on 05.01.2003 for hearing the said application. After hearing the application in part 22.02.2003 was fixed for further hearing, but the plaintiff-respondent No. 1 herein did not take any steps in this regard and the case proceeded to trial. The learned advocate further submits that the deposition of the plaintiff clearly shows that he did not pay to the plaintiff any sum of money other than the initial payment of Tk. 15,00,000/-, which is admitted in his cross-examination. The learned advocate submits that both the trial Court and the High Court Division have not properly considered the material evidence and without considering that the plaintiff-respondent No. 1 was not willing take the Kabla within the stipulated time and upon taking a false plea of making bank-draft and tendering photocopies to the petitioner, he claimed to have paid further Tk. 29,00,000/- which he contradicted in his cross-examination. He submits further that the plaintiff was not able to prove his case by his own evidence, but the High Court Division shifted the burden of proof on the defendant and as such the judgment and decree is liable to be set aside.
